title: Type A Nilpotent Hessenberg varieties with Hessenberg function $h(i)\le i+1$
summary: We study the type A nilpotent Hessenberg varieties associated with Hessenberg functions that satisfy $h(i)\le i+1$. We call these the generalized parabolic Peterson varieties. We show that such varieties can be decomposed into the union of specific generalized parabolic Peterson varieties $\operatorname{Pet}_{λ,α}$, such that $λ$ is an integer partition, $α$ is an integer composition, and $α$ is dominated by $λ$.
